title: Meet Lady Showbird, Duff Goldman’s Turkey Cake
summary: Duff Goldman’s Lady Showbird is a turkey that’s actually a cake: pumpkin layer cake, vanilla buttercream, and cranberry filling. A limited-edition Goldbelly exclusive.

## The Thanksgiving 2026 bird that’s really dessert


Lady Showbird is a turkey cake: a dessert that looks exactly like a golden roast turkey on a silver platter but is cake all the way through. Celebrity baker Duff Goldman and his team at Charm City Cakes handcraft each one, with layers of pumpkin cake, vanilla buttercream, and tart cranberry filling. It’s a limited-edition Goldbelly exclusive, made for the **[Thanksgiving](https://www.goldbelly.com/spotlight/thanksgiving)** table.


No brining, no basting, and no carving board required. Just a knife, a platter, and a crowd ready to be fooled.


[Shop the Lady Showbird Turkey Cake on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/duff-goldman/lady-showbird-turkey-cake)


## **What’s inside the Lady Showbird turkey cake?**


From the outside, Lady Showbird looks like a perfectly roasted turkey, from her glossy golden-brown skin to her drumsticks and the garnish on her platter. Every detail is edible. Inside, she’s all classic Thanksgiving dessert flavor:


- **Pumpkin layer cake:** moist and lightly spiced
- **Vanilla buttercream:** smooth and rich
- **Cranberry filling:** a tart contrast to the sweet cake


It’s pumpkin pie and cranberry sauce in one cake, dressed up as the main course.


## **Who is Duff Goldman?**


**[Duff Goldman](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/duff-goldman)** is the baker and owner of Charm City Cakes in Baltimore, famous for over-the-top custom cakes. He became a household name as the star of Food Network’s *Ace of Cakes* and has since appeared on shows including *Kids Baking Championship* . Lady Showbird brings his signature showpiece style to the Thanksgiving table.


## **Where can you order Lady Showbird?**


**[Order Duff Goldman’s Lady Showbird Turkey Cake on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/duff-goldman/lady-showbird-turkey-cake) .** Each cake serves 10–12 and ships nationwide.
